notes.title: The demo version has been released!
notes.content:
Welcome to all fans of Breakout games!

We are pleased to announce that the demo version of the game is now available for download!

The features of the demo version:


 all resources are included, nothing is cut out
 all 3 packs are available, but each of them has only 10 levels
 full binary compatibility with the main version of the game
 shared saved with the full version of the game

We hope that you will enjoy our game. And we will be grateful for any feedback - what you liked, what annoyed, any wishes to the developers - preferably friendly:)

We wish you a fun time! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Announcement of the demo version
notes.content:
Hello all lovers of retro Breakout games!

We have good news for you! The demo version will be available on January 20. It will have full binary compatibility with the full version of the game, so we have a big request to you: "Help us to test its functionality". If you have any problems or questions, be sure to post them on the forum!

Features of the demo version:

 all resources are included, nothing is cut out
 all 3 packs are available, but each of them has only 10 levels
 full binary compatibility with the main version of the game
 shared saves with the full version of the game
 no level editor yet


Thank you for your attention and take care! ːlunar2019piginablanketː

notes.title: Roadmap & Release Date
notes.content:
Hi!

We had some free time and decided to release our old game Action Ball on Steam. Naturally it's been out for a long time, but we wanted to update it a bit. That's why we don't publish it right away.

Well, this is what we plan to do in the near future:


First, we will prepare a demo version of the game to test the performance of all our improvements.
Secondly we are planning several tutorials. For example how to add your video resolution into the game. Or how to use the level editor.
And the last, we want to participate in the indie game festival, where we'll share more details about how we've been upgrading the game.


And the planned release date is March 14.

Cheers and good luck in the new year! Stay tuned, there will be a lot of news!
